crossRefs.note: Then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.
There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.
When they came to the place that is called “The Skull”, they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right…
where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.

parallels.note: He said to her, “What do you want?” She said to him, “Command that these, my two sons, may sit, one on your right hand…
Then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.

translations.web: With him they crucified two robbers; one on his right hand, and one on his left.
translations.bsb: Along with Jesus, they crucified two robbers, one on His right and one on His left.
translations.kjv: And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.
translations.asv: And with him they crucify two robbers; one on his right hand, and one on his left.
